name: docs-getting-started-migration-md-00
yaml:
# Before (Mountebank)
services:
  mountebank:
    image: bbyars/mountebank:2.9.2
    ports:
      - "2525:2525"
    command: ["start", "--allowInjection"]

# After (Rift)
services:
  rift:
    image: zainalpour/rift-proxy:latest
    ports:
      - "2525:2525"
    environment:
      - MB_ALLOW_INJECTION=true
